meta_title: TrueNorth Living — Sober Living Homes in North Texas
meta_description: Structured, peer-supported sober living homes in Dallas, Denton, and Arlington. Real beds, honest availability, and people who answer the phone. Apply in under five minutes.

hero.title: Somebody left the light on.
hero.subtitle: TrueNorth Living is opening small, structured sober living homes across North Texas. No waiting rooms. No runaround. Call us and a person picks up.

path_title: What the next ninety days actually look like
path_intro: Nobody hands you a brochure and wishes you luck. Here is the real shape of it.

path.label: You reach out
path.detail: A phone call or a form at 3am. We answer, we ask a few questions, and we tell you straight whether we have a bed and whether we're the right fit. If we're not, we'll tell you who is.

path.label: You move in
path.detail: Usually within 48 hours. You get a bed, a key, a drawer, and a house that already knows your name. First week you're just finding the coffee.

path.label: You find footing
path.detail: Weekly house meeting, daily check-in, a curfew that loosens as you earn it. We help you get to work, to meetings, to court if that's where you need to be.

path.label: You go the distance
path.detail: Most people stay six to nine months. Some become house leaders. Some move out and come back for Sunday dinner. The door doesn't close behind you.

pillars.title: Small on purpose
pillars.body: Six to ten residents per house. Big enough for a real community, small enough that your absence is noticed the same day.

pillars.title: Structure you can feel
pillars.body: Curfew, chores, house meetings, and random testing. Not to punish — because the shape of a day is the thing most of us lost first.

pillars.title: Peer-led, not managed
pillars.body: House leaders are residents who've been where you are. Staff support the house; the house runs itself. That's the part that sticks.

pillars.title: Honest about money
pillars.body: One weekly rate, posted publicly. No intake fee, no surprise charges. If you hit a rough patch, come talk to us before you disappear.
